changes.title: Trump Dismisses Reports About Dire Conditions Aboard U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln
changes.summary: Asked whether the deployment of the Abraham Lincoln had gone on too long, the president said its deployment had lasted “not nearly long enough.”.

changes.title: Justice Department expands military's power to detain migrants accused of trespassing
changes.summary: The Justice Department issued a legal opinion giving the U.S. military broader powers to detain migrants near certain areas along the southern border.

changes.title: U.S. retail sales unexpectedly post largest drop in more than a year
changes.summary: The drop in spending raised concern among some economists about the resiliency of consumers who have powered the economy forward despite nagging inflation and soaring gasoline prices.

changes.title: USS Washington aircraft carrier heads to Middle East to replace USS Lincoln
changes.summary: The USS George Washington aircraft carrier departed Vietnam last week and is headed to the Middle East to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln, according to a U.S. official.

changes.title: Magnitude-7.7 quake hits off coast of Indonesia and tsunami warning issued
changes.summary: A magnitude-7.7 earthquake hit off the coast of Indonesia in the eastern Flores region, the United States Geological Survey reported on Friday.

changes.title: Brooks and Atkins Stohr on 'woke' politics in America
changes.summary: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Kimberly Atkins Stohr of the Boston Globe join William Brangham to discuss the week in politics, including the surprising result in Wisconsin's Democratic primary, the status of 'woke' politics in America and the stalemate between the U.S. and Iran.

changes.title: New aircraft carrier en route to Middle East after issues reported aboard USS Abraham Lincoln
changes.summary: The Lincoln has been supporting the U.S. war against Iran, and its deployment has included a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea of more than 240 days.

changes.title: Green roofs can help cool cities in the summer heat, but building them is only the first step. Many don't survive
changes.summary: As summer temperatures soar across the United States and Europe, cities are being forced to confront the difficult reality that they're getting dangerously hot.

changes.title: Navy and USS Lincoln’s Problems Are Tied to Attacks on U.S. Base Early in War
changes.summary: Diego Garcia, a tiny island 2,200 miles from the Gulf of Oman, took over as the Navy’s logistics hub after Iran damaged a base in Bahrain.
